---
title: "Computer Literacy Practice"
---

A self-guided, hands-on collection of walkthroughs for building command-line literacy. Pick the version that matches both your machine and the amount of time you have to spend.

## MacOS

- [**Quick Start**](macos-quickstart.qmd) — a focused, ~30–45 minute tour of the handful of command-line moves you will use most often, organized around a single running example.
- [**Extended**](macos-extended.qmd) — a full ~2.5 hour walkthrough with deep vocabulary callouts, comprehension challenges, and a 30-question review at the end.

## Windows

- [**Quick Start**](windows-quickstart.qmd) — a focused, ~30–45 minute tour built for the Anaconda PowerShell Prompt, organized around a single running example.
- [**Extended**](windows-extended.qmd) — a full ~2.5 hour walkthrough built for the Anaconda PowerShell Prompt, with deep vocabulary callouts, comprehension challenges, and a 30-question review at the end.

---

Each walkthrough shows a prompt, and the answer to every challenge is hidden behind a **Click to reveal answer** panel. Try the challenge on your own first; only reveal the answer when you are stuck or want to check your work.
